info.title: Javier Chua Portfolio API
info.description: Public read-only portfolio data: profile, Positions, Projects, Skills, and contact guidelines. Canonical data routes use /api/v1; unversioned routes and .json forms remain compatible aliases. No authentication is required. GET and HEAD are supported. Error responses use the typed ErrorResponse envelope.

get.description: Identity, Education, public social links, and current Position (or null).

200.description: Portfolio data successfully retrieved.

head.summary: Retrieve profile headers without a response body

200.description: Portfolio data successfully retrieved. HEAD returns no body.

404.description: The data endpoint does not exist. HEAD returns no body.

405.description: Only GET and HEAD are supported. HEAD returns no body.

406.description: The data route supports application/json and compatible wildcards. HEAD returns no body.

503.description: A generated data asset is unavailable. HEAD returns no body.

message.example: The requested API endpoint does not exist.

resolution.example: Check the OpenAPI specification at /openapi.json or documentation at /api/.

ErrorResponse.description: JSON error envelope used by data API errors. HEAD returns the same status and headers without a body.

description.example: Javier Chua is a Computer Science student at NUS, interested in backend systems and network engineering.

currentPosition.description: The first current Position in the shared reverse-chronological data at build time, or null. Dates are compared inclusively using the build UTC calendar date; future Positions are excluded.

prominence.description: Subjective display weight for size and within-category ordering, not proficiency.

x-versioning-policy.breakingChanges: Breaking response or behavior changes require a new major version path. Additive optional fields may be introduced within v1.
x-versioning-policy.legacyAliases: Unversioned /api/{resource} and .json forms remain backward-compatible aliases; they are not currently deprecated.
x-versioning-policy.retirementNotice: If retirement is scheduled, announce it at least 90 days before removal, publish migration guidance, and emit Deprecation (RFC 9745 structured date) and Sunset (RFC 8594 HTTP-date) response headers on affected routes.
